articles.title: Ripple raises $200 million from Neuberger Berman to expand its Ripple Prime platform
articles.snippet: Ripple announced its agreement with the global investment firm Monday, noting that Ripple Prime’s revenue has tripled in the last year, when. it acquired it for $1.25 billion.

articles.title: Strategy buys 535 bitcoin for $43 million days after signaling potential BTC sales
articles.snippet: Last week's purchases were funded by sales of the company's common stock.

articles.title: Bitcoin mining pools with 75% of BTC hashrate join open standard for block construction
articles.snippet: Foundry, AntPool, F2Pool, SpiderPool, and MARA Pool are among seven pools joining the Stratum V2 working group, putting nearly three-quarters of global bitcoin hashrate behind a protocol that returns block construction decisions to individual miners.

articles.title: Australia plans capital gains tax changes affecting crypto investors: Report
articles.snippet: The Albanese government’s budget plans to replace the 50% capital gains tax discount on assets held over 12 months with a model taxing full real gains adjusted for inflation.

articles.title: Canton Network creator targets $300M in capital raise: Report
articles.snippet: Bloomberg reported Digital Asset Holdings is raising money at a $2B valuation in a round led by a16z Crypto, which comes less than a year after an earlier nine-figure round.
